title: ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT~ESO New Technology Telescope
focus: 3.58 m 薄鏡主動光學望遠鏡：薄鏡支撐、Shack–Hartmann 波前量測、熱控圓頂與影像品質預算~A 3.58 m thin-mirror active-optics telescope: meniscus support, Shack–Hartmann wavefront sensing, thermally controlled enclosure and image-quality budgets
summary: 以 ESO 1989 年啟用的 NTT 為對象，解析為何 24 cm 厚的 3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡必須靠 75 個軸向主動支撐與離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 分析儀維持面形，八角形旋轉圓頂與鏡面溫控如何壓低局部視寧度，以及如何把光學、追蹤、鏡面視寧度與大氣視寧度合成可驗收的影像品質預算。~Using ESO's NTT, commissioned in 1989, this course explains why a 3.58 m Zerodur meniscus only 24 cm thick must rely on 75 active axial supports and an off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann analyser to hold its figure, how the octagonal rotating enclosure and mirror temperature control suppress local seeing, and how optics, tracking, mirror seeing and atmospheric seeing combine into an acceptable image-quality budget.

units.anchor: 3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡~3.58 m Zerodur meniscus
units.title: 薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯~Why a thin mirror needs active optics
units.mechanism: 傳統望遠鏡主鏡以直徑／厚度約 6 到 8 的厚鏡坯靠自身剛性維持面形，但重量與熱慣性隨尺寸急速增長。NTT 改用厚度僅 24 cm、直徑 3.58 m 的 Zerodur 彎月薄鏡，重量約 6 t，自重彎曲與溫度梯度造成的面形誤差不再靠剛性抵抗，而是由支撐系統中的主動力與量測回授來修正。這把望遠鏡從「做得夠硬」改成「量得準、修得快」，是主動光學的核心轉變，也讓後來 8 m 級 VLT 的 17.5 cm 薄鏡成為可能。~A classical primary with diameter-to-thickness ratio of about 6 to 8 holds its figure by stiffness alone, but mass and thermal inertia grow rapidly with size. The NTT instead uses a Zerodur meniscus 3.58 m across and only 24 cm thick, about 6 t, whose self-weight bending and thermal-gradient errors are no longer resisted by stiffness but corrected by active forces in the support system under measurement feedback. This shifts the telescope from being built stiff enough to being measured accurately and corrected quickly, the central change of active optics, and it made the 17.5 cm meniscus of the later 8 m VLT possible.
units.model: 鏡坯質量 m = ρ·π(D/2)²·t：ρ = 2530 kg/m³、D = 3.58 m 時，傳統 D/t = 8（t = 0.45 m）的鏡坯重 2530×10.07×0.45 ≈ 11.4 t，NTT 的 t = 0.24 m 則為 2530×10.07×0.24 ≈ 6.1 t。板的彎曲撓度正比於 D⁴/t²，所以在同直徑下薄鏡的柔度是厚鏡的 (0.45/0.24)² ≈ 3.5 倍，必須由主動支撐補償。~Blank mass m = ρ·π(D/2)²·t: with ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and D = 3.58 m, a classical D/t = 8 blank (t = 0.45 m) weighs 2530×10.07×0.45 ≈ 11.4 t, while the NTT's t = 0.24 m gives 2530×10.07×0.24 ≈ 6.1 t. Plate bending deflection scales as D⁴/t², so at the same diameter the thin mirror is (0.45/0.24)² ≈ 3.5 times more compliant and must be compensated by active support.
units.verify: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在天頂與 60° 天頂距下的自重變形，分解成 Zernike 項並與望遠鏡在相同姿態下由影像分析儀量到的像散與三葉像差比較；兩者的低階項應在數十奈米內吻合，否則檢查支撐邊界條件的建模。~Compute the self-weight deformation of the blank at zenith and at 60° zenith distance with a finite-element model, decompose it into Zernike terms and compare with the astigmatism and trefoil measured by the image analyser at the same attitudes; the low-order terms should agree within tens of nanometres, otherwise revisit the modelled support boundary conditions.
units.failure: 把薄鏡當成剛性鏡安裝、支撐力只按靜態平均分配時，鏡面隨天頂距變化會出現數微米的像散，星像變成橢圓並隨指向方向轉動，任何固定的光學校準都無法消除。~Mounting the thin mirror as if it were rigid, with support forces set only to the static average, produces micrometres of astigmatism that change with zenith distance; star images become elliptical and rotate with pointing direction, and no fixed optical alignment can remove it.
units.misconception: 鏡子越薄越容易變形，所以薄鏡望遠鏡的影像一定比厚鏡差。~Thinner mirrors deform more, so a thin-mirror telescope must give worse images.

units.anchor: Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與 Nasmyth 焦點~Ritchey–Chrétien train and Nasmyth foci
units.title: 影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬~Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction
units.mechanism: NTT 是 f/2.2 主鏡、f/11 Nasmyth 焦點的 Ritchey–Chrétien 經緯儀望遠鏡，兩個 Nasmyth 平台各掛一組儀器。地面望遠鏡的影像由大氣視寧度主導，主動光學的目標不是達到繞射極限，而是讓望遠鏡本身的像差、追蹤與局部視寧度貢獻遠小於大氣項。主動修正的對象是重力、溫度與製造殘差這些變化慢的低階像差，因此修正週期以數十秒到數分鐘計；高頻的大氣擾動留給之後的自適應光學。~The NTT is an alt-azimuth Ritchey–Chrétien telescope with an f/2.2 primary and f/11 Nasmyth foci, with an instrument on each Nasmyth platform. Ground-based images are dominated by atmospheric seeing, so the aim of active optics is not the diffraction limit but to keep the telescope's own aberrations, tracking and local seeing far below the atmospheric term. Active correction targets slowly varying low-order aberrations from gravity, temperature and manufacturing residuals, so the correction cycle is tens of seconds to minutes; fast atmospheric turbulence is left to later adaptive optics.
units.model: Kolmogorov 視寧度與望遠鏡像質的合成常以 5/3 次方相加：FWHM_total ≈ (θ_seeing^(5/3) + θ_tel^(5/3))^(3/5)。θ_seeing = 0.60″、θ_tel = 0.15″ 時 (0.4268 + 0.0424)^(0.6) ≈ 0.635″，望遠鏡只增加 0.035″；若 θ_tel = 0.40″ 則 (0.4268 + 0.2172)^(0.6) ≈ 0.768″。作為對照，Maréchal 判準 λ/14 在 500 nm 約為 36 nm RMS 波前。~Kolmogorov seeing and telescope image quality are commonly combined in 5/3 power: FWHM_total ≈ (θ_seeing^(5/3) + θ_tel^(5/3))^(3/5). With θ_seeing = 0.60″ and θ_tel = 0.15″, (0.4268 + 0.0424)^(0.6) ≈ 0.635″, so the telescope adds only 0.035″; with θ_tel = 0.40″ it becomes (0.4268 + 0.2172)^(0.6) ≈ 0.768″. For reference the Maréchal criterion λ/14 at 500 nm is about 36 nm RMS wavefront.
units.verify: 在同一夜以站址的差分影像運動監測儀（DIMM）記錄視寧度，同時量焦面上星像的 FWHM，把兩者以 5/3 次方相減反推望遠鏡項；若反推的 θ_tel 隨天頂距或時間系統性變化，就把主動光學的殘餘像差紀錄對照，找出是光學、追蹤還是熱的貢獻。~On one night record the seeing with the site differential image motion monitor (DIMM) while measuring stellar FWHM at the focal plane, then subtract in 5/3 power to back out the telescope term; if the inferred θ_tel varies systematically with zenith distance or time, compare it with the active-optics residual log to attribute it to optics, tracking or thermal effects.
units.failure: 若把主動光學迴路頻寬提高到試圖跟上大氣像散，量測雜訊會被放大注入鏡面，支撐力不停振盪，星像反而比開環更差，還會讓致動器提前磨損。~Raising the active-optics loop bandwidth to chase atmospheric astigmatism injects amplified measurement noise into the mirror; support forces oscillate, images become worse than open loop and the actuators wear out early.
units.misconception: 主動光學和自適應光學只是修正速度不同，原理完全一樣。~Active and adaptive optics are the same thing, only at different speeds.

units.anchor: 75 個軸向主動支撐~75 active axial supports
units.title: 鏡坯、軸向與側向支撐與致動力~Blank, axial and lateral supports and actuator forces
units.mechanism: NTT 主鏡坯由 Schott 製造的 Zerodur 玻璃陶瓷鑄成，熱膨脹係數接近零，研磨拋光後裝在 75 個軸向支撐與一組側向支撐上。每個軸向支撐是帶可動配重的靜力槓桿（astatic lever），被動地承擔隨姿態變化的大部分重量，再由電動致動器疊加一個小的修正力；三個固定點定義鏡面位置。修正力的空間分佈決定能產生哪些彎曲模態：像散、三葉、四葉等低階模態只需要幾十牛頓級的力，而高階模態需要的力迅速增大且會引入支撐印痕。~The NTT primary is cast in Zerodur glass ceramic by Schott, with near-zero thermal expansion, and after figuring it rests on 75 axial supports plus a set of lateral supports. Each axial support is an astatic lever with a movable counterweight that passively carries most of the attitude-dependent load, while an electric actuator superimposes a small correction force; three fixed points define the mirror position. The spatial pattern of the correction forces determines which bending modes can be generated: low-order modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and quadrafoil need only tens of newtons, while higher modes demand rapidly growing forces and introduce support print-through.
units.model: 平均軸向力 F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N。產生 1 µm PV 像散（振幅 a = 0.5 µm）所需的彎矩 M = D_f(1−ν)·2a/R²，其中板剛度 D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] = 90.3×10⁹×0.24³/(12×0.942) ≈ 1.1×10⁸ N·m，R = 1.79 m，得 M ≈ 1.1×10⁸×0.76×3.1×10⁻⁷ ≈ 26 N·m/m；以外圈兩環支撐相距 0.4 m 形成力偶、外圈支撐間距約 0.25 m，每個支撐約需 ±17 N，只占平均負載的 2%（教學估計）。~Mean axial force F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N. Generating 1 µm PV astigmatism (amplitude a = 0.5 µm) needs a bending moment M = D_f(1−ν)·2a/R², with plate stiffness D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] = 90.3×10⁹×0.24³/(12×0.942) ≈ 1.1×10⁸ N·m and R = 1.79 m, giving M ≈ 1.1×10⁸×0.76×3.1×10⁻⁷ ≈ 26 N·m/m; with a force couple across the outer two support rings 0.4 m apart and an outer-ring spacing of about 0.25 m, each support needs about ±17 N, only 2% of the mean load (teaching estimate).
units.verify: 在鏡室測試台上以荷重元逐一校正每個致動器的力對指令曲線，確認解析度與遲滯；再施加設計的像散力型並用干涉儀或影像分析儀量鏡面響應，比較實測的模態增益（nm/N）與有限元素預測，建立影響矩陣供控制迴路使用。~On the mirror-cell test stand calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve with a load cell, confirming resolution and hysteresis; then apply the designed astigmatism force pattern and measure the mirror response with an interferometer or the image analyser, comparing the measured modal gain (nm/N) with the finite-element prediction to build the influence matrix used by the control loop.
units.failure: 某個致動器卡死或荷重元漂移時，該點力誤差數十牛頓會在鏡面留下局部印痕，星像出現三葉或高階結構；若控制迴路仍以該致動器正常為前提求解，修正量會錯誤分配到鄰近支撐，越修越差。~A stuck actuator or a drifting load cell leaves a local print-through from a force error of tens of newtons, and star images show trefoil or higher-order structure; if the loop keeps solving as though that actuator worked, corrections are misallocated to neighbouring supports and the figure gets worse with each cycle.
units.misconception: 支撐點越多，主動光學就能修正任意高階的像差。~With enough support points active optics can correct arbitrarily high-order aberrations.

units.anchor: 八角形旋轉圓頂與通風百葉~Octagonal rotating enclosure and ventilation louvres
units.title: 圓頂熱設計與鏡面視寧度~Enclosure thermal design and mirror seeing
units.mechanism: NTT 的圓頂是高約 18 m、直徑約 17 m 的八角形建築，整棟隨望遠鏡旋轉，牆面靠近望遠鏡以減少內部熱源與滯留空氣，側壁的通風百葉與擋風網讓夜風以可控方式流過主鏡，把鏡面與周圍空氣的溫差帶走。鏡面比空氣熱時，貼近鏡面的空氣層產生對流與折射率擾動，形成所謂鏡面視寧度，其影響可超過光學誤差；因此白天把鏡室降溫至預期夜間氣溫、夜間維持通風，是影像品質預算的一部分。~The NTT enclosure is an octagonal building about 18 m high and 17 m across that rotates with the telescope; its walls sit close to the telescope to limit internal heat sources and trapped air, and side louvres with a windscreen let the night wind flush the primary in a controlled way, carrying off the temperature difference between mirror and air. A mirror warmer than the air drives convection and refractive-index turbulence in the boundary layer, the so-called mirror seeing, whose effect can exceed the optical errors; cooling the mirror cell by day to the expected night temperature and ventilating at night is therefore part of the image-quality budget.
units.model: 鏡面視寧度的經驗關係 θ_mirror ≈ 0.38·ΔT^1.2 角秒（ΔT 為鏡面高於空氣的溫度，K；教學用經驗值）：ΔT = 0.3 K 時 θ ≈ 0.09″，1 K 時 0.38″，2 K 時 0.87″。24 cm Zerodur 的熱時間常數 τ ≈ t²/(π²α)，α = κ/(ρc) = 1.46/(2530×800) ≈ 7.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s，得 τ ≈ 0.0576/(9.87×7.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 8100 s ≈ 2.3 h，所以鏡面跟不上黃昏的快速降溫。~An empirical mirror-seeing relation is θ_mirror ≈ 0.38·ΔT^1.2 arcseconds (ΔT the mirror excess over air in K; a teaching value): ΔT = 0.3 K gives θ ≈ 0.09″, 1 K gives 0.38″ and 2 K gives 0.87″. The thermal time constant of 24 cm of Zerodur is τ ≈ t²/(π²α) with α = κ/(ρc) = 1.46/(2530×800) ≈ 7.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s, so τ ≈ 0.0576/(9.87×7.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 8100 s ≈ 2.3 h, and the mirror cannot follow the rapid cooling at dusk.
units.verify: 在鏡面邊緣與背面裝多點溫度感測器並記錄圓頂內外氣溫，夜間每小時量一次星像 FWHM；把 FWHM 減去 DIMM 視寧度後對 ΔT 作圖，應呈現接近 ΔT^1.2 的趨勢，並據此設定白天鏡室空調的目標溫度與夜間百葉開度。~Fit several temperature sensors at the mirror edge and back, log the air temperature inside and outside the enclosure and measure stellar FWHM hourly; plot FWHM minus DIMM seeing against ΔT, expect a trend close to ΔT^1.2, and use it to set the daytime mirror-cell air-conditioning target and the night-time louvre opening.
units.failure: 白天圓頂空調失效或設定溫度比夜間氣溫高 3 K 時，入夜後鏡面持續放熱數小時，星像 FWHM 比視寧度差 0.5″ 以上，主動光學再怎麼修正面形也救不回來，整夜的高解析度觀測作廢。~If the daytime enclosure air conditioning fails or is set 3 K above the night air temperature, the mirror keeps releasing heat for hours after dark, stellar FWHM exceeds the seeing by more than 0.5″, no amount of active figure correction recovers it and the night's high-resolution observations are lost.
units.misconception: 只要圓頂開口夠大，鏡面溫度就不重要。~With a wide enough enclosure opening the mirror temperature does not matter.

units.anchor: 離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 影像分析儀~Off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann image analyser
units.title: 波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解~Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition
units.mechanism: NTT 的影像分析儀在科學視場之外取一顆參考星，用微透鏡陣列把出瞳分成子孔徑，每個子孔徑在 CCD 上成一個光點，光點相對參考位置的位移正比於該處的波前斜率。把所有斜率最小平方擬合成 Zernike 或鏡面的彈性模態後，離焦交給副鏡的軸向位移、彗差交給副鏡的橫向位移或傾斜，像散、三葉與球差則轉成主鏡的支撐力修正。量測在數十秒的積分中把大氣擾動平均掉，因此參考星的亮度與積分時間共同決定波前精度。~The NTT image analyser picks a reference star outside the science field, divides the exit pupil into sub-apertures with a lenslet array and forms one spot per sub-aperture on a CCD; each spot's displacement from its reference position is proportional to the local wavefront slope. After least-squares fitting the slopes to Zernike or mirror elastic modes, defocus is assigned to the axial motion of the secondary, coma to its lateral motion or tilt, and astigmatism, trefoil and spherical to primary-support force corrections. The integration of tens of seconds averages atmospheric turbulence, so the reference star brightness and the integration time together set the wavefront accuracy.
units.model: 子孔徑斜率雜訊換算成波前誤差：σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N，其中 d_sub 為子孔徑在主鏡上的尺寸、θ_spot 為光點角尺寸、N 為光子數。取 20×20 子孔徑（d_sub = 0.18 m）、θ_spot = 1″ = 4.85×10⁻⁶ rad、V ≈ 12 的星在 200 nm 頻寬、30% 效率下 30 s 約收到 N ≈ 9000 個光子：σ_θ = 4.85×10⁻⁶/95 ≈ 5.1×10⁻⁸ rad，σ_W ≈ 0.18×5.1×10⁻⁸ ≈ 9 nm。~Converting sub-aperture slope noise into wavefront error: σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N, with d_sub the sub-aperture size on the primary, θ_spot the angular spot size and N the photon count. For 20×20 sub-apertures (d_sub = 0.18 m), θ_spot = 1″ = 4.85×10⁻⁶ rad and a V ≈ 12 star delivering N ≈ 9000 photons in 30 s over a 200 nm band at 30% efficiency: σ_θ = 4.85×10⁻⁶/95 ≈ 5.1×10⁻⁸ rad and σ_W ≈ 0.18×5.1×10⁻⁸ ≈ 9 nm.
units.verify: 以內部參考光源建立微透鏡光點的零點位置，再對一顆星連續取十組 30 s 量測，計算各 Zernike 係數的重複性，應與 σ_W 預測同量級；接著故意讓副鏡偏離焦點 50 µm，確認分析儀量到的離焦與幾何預測一致，驗證標定比例。~Establish the lenslet spot reference positions with an internal calibration source, then take ten consecutive 30 s measurements on one star and compute the repeatability of each Zernike coefficient, which should be of the same order as the predicted σ_W; next defocus the secondary deliberately by 50 µm and confirm that the measured defocus matches the geometric prediction, verifying the calibration scale.
units.failure: 參考星附近有伴星或分析儀出瞳對不準微透鏡陣列時，部分子孔徑的光點質心偏移，擬合出假的三葉像差並送到主鏡支撐，星像被修出三角形；只看殘差 RMS 不看光點品質的流程不會發現。~A companion star near the reference or a pupil misregistered on the lenslet array shifts the centroids of some sub-apertures, the fit produces false trefoil that is sent to the primary supports and star images are corrected into triangles; a procedure that watches only the residual RMS and not spot quality never notices.
units.misconception: 參考星越暗越好，因為亮星會讓 CCD 飽和。~Fainter reference stars are better because bright stars saturate the CCD.

units.anchor: 影像品質預算表與指向模型~Image-quality budget and pointing model
units.title: 追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算~Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget
units.mechanism: NTT 的指向誤差約 1.5″ RMS，由含數十項幾何與撓曲項的指向模型修正；追蹤抖動、風荷載與軸承摩擦則以導星回授壓低。影像品質預算把光學殘差、追蹤抖動、鏡面視寧度與圓頂視寧度各自換成等效的 FWHM 貢獻，先以均方根合成望遠鏡項，再與大氣視寧度以 5/3 次方合成；每一項都要有量測方法與允收值，才能在影像變差時快速定位責任項目。~The NTT points to about 1.5″ RMS using a pointing model with tens of geometric and flexure terms, while tracking jitter, wind load and bearing friction are suppressed by autoguider feedback. The image-quality budget converts optical residual, tracking jitter, mirror seeing and dome seeing into equivalent FWHM contributions, combines them root-sum-square into a telescope term and then combines that with atmospheric seeing in 5/3 power; every item needs a measurement method and an allowance so that a degraded image can be traced quickly to the responsible term.
units.model: 追蹤抖動 σ = 0.10″ RMS 的等效 FWHM ≈ 2.355σ = 0.235″；與光學殘差 0.20″、鏡面視寧度 0.15″ 做 RSS：√(0.235² + 0.20² + 0.15²) = √0.118 ≈ 0.34″。再與 0.60″ 視寧度合成：(0.60^(5/3) + 0.34^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.427 + 0.166)^(0.6) ≈ 0.73″。指向模型殘差 1.5″ 不進入 FWHM，但決定目標能否落入導星與狹縫範圍。~Tracking jitter of σ = 0.10″ RMS is an equivalent FWHM of ≈ 2.355σ = 0.235″; root-sum-squared with a 0.20″ optical residual and 0.15″ mirror seeing: √(0.235² + 0.20² + 0.15²) = √0.118 ≈ 0.34″. Combined with 0.60″ seeing: (0.60^(5/3) + 0.34^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.427 + 0.166)^(0.6) ≈ 0.73″. The 1.5″ pointing residual does not enter the FWHM but decides whether targets land within the guider and slit acquisition range.
units.verify: 全天指向校正：對均勻分佈的 50 到 100 顆星量指向偏差並擬合模型，紀錄殘差 RMS 與其對天頂距的趨勢；追蹤抖動則以導星 CCD 高頻取樣星像質心的功率譜量得，並確認風速增加時抖動的增量與預算相符。~All-sky pointing calibration: measure the pointing offsets of 50 to 100 stars distributed over the sky, fit the model and record the residual RMS and its trend with zenith distance; measure tracking jitter from the power spectrum of star centroids sampled at high rate on the guider CCD, and confirm that the jitter increase with wind speed stays within the budget.
units.failure: 把指向殘差 1.5″ 當成影像模糊項直接加進預算，或把 PV 與 RMS 混用，會讓預算表顯示不合格而引發錯誤的硬體更換；反過來漏掉圓頂視寧度，則在低風夜晚出現無法解釋的影像劣化。~Entering the 1.5″ pointing residual as a blur term, or mixing peak-to-valley with RMS, makes the budget appear to fail and triggers needless hardware replacement; omitting dome seeing instead leaves unexplained image degradation on calm nights.
units.misconception: 指向越準，星像就越銳利。~The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images.

units.anchor: 主動光學控制迴路與查表~Active-optics control loop and lookup tables
units.title: 開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均~Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging
units.mechanism: 主動光學的控制分兩層：開環以天頂距與溫度為索引的查表預先設定支撐力與副鏡位置，閉環則用影像分析儀每隔數十秒量一次殘餘像差並以低增益修正。閉環量測中混有大氣造成的低階像差，其相關時間約為口徑除以風速，所以積分時間越長，大氣項平均得越乾淨；增益則在收斂速度與雜訊放大之間取捨。NTT 在 1997 年的全面升級中把控制系統改成 VLT 架構，成為後者的原型。~Active-optics control has two layers: an open-loop table indexed by zenith distance and temperature presets the support forces and secondary position, and a closed loop measures the residual aberration with the image analyser every few tens of seconds and corrects it with low gain. The closed-loop measurement is contaminated by atmospheric low-order aberrations whose correlation time is roughly the aperture divided by wind speed, so longer integrations average the atmosphere more cleanly, while the gain trades convergence speed against noise amplification. In its 1997 overhaul the NTT control system was rebuilt on the VLT architecture and became its prototype.
units.model: Noll 公式給出單一像散模態的大氣變異數約 0.023·(D/r₀)^(5/3) rad²：D = 3.58 m、r₀ = 0.15 m 時 (23.9)^(5/3) ≈ 198，變異數 ≈ 4.6 rad²，σ ≈ 2.1 rad ≈ 170 nm（λ = 500 nm）。相關時間 τ₀ ≈ D/v = 3.58/10 ≈ 0.36 s，30 s 積分含約 83 個獨立樣本，平均後殘餘 ≈ 170/√83 ≈ 19 nm，已低於 36 nm 的 λ/14 判準。~Noll's result gives an atmospheric variance of about 0.023·(D/r₀)^(5/3) rad² for one astigmatism mode: with D = 3.58 m and r₀ = 0.15 m, (23.9)^(5/3) ≈ 198, the variance ≈ 4.6 rad² and σ ≈ 2.1 rad ≈ 170 nm at λ = 500 nm. The correlation time is τ₀ ≈ D/v = 3.58/10 ≈ 0.36 s, so a 30 s integration holds about 83 independent samples and the averaged residual is ≈ 170/√83 ≈ 19 nm, below the 36 nm λ/14 criterion.
units.verify: 閉環運轉時記錄每次量測的像散與離焦係數時間序列，計算其功率譜：主動修正應只壓低低於迴路頻寬的成分，高於頻寬的部分應與大氣模型預測一致；再改變積分時間（10 s、30 s、60 s）確認殘餘雜訊按 1/√T 下降。~While the loop is closed, log the time series of astigmatism and defocus coefficients from each measurement and compute their power spectra: active correction should suppress only components below the loop bandwidth, and the part above it should match the atmospheric model; then change the integration time (10 s, 30 s, 60 s) and confirm that the residual noise falls as 1/√T.
units.failure: 開環查表若以錯誤的溫度感測器為索引，入夜降溫時預設力偏離數十牛頓，閉環需要多個週期才能追回，期間星像帶著明顯像散；若此時操作員手動提高增益，迴路可能進入振盪。~If the open-loop table is indexed by a faulty temperature sensor, the preset forces drift by tens of newtons as the night cools, the closed loop needs several cycles to catch up and star images carry visible astigmatism meanwhile; an operator who raises the gain by hand can push the loop into oscillation.
units.misconception: 閉環修正後就不需要開環查表了。~Once the closed loop works, the open-loop lookup table is unnecessary.

units.anchor: 調試紀錄與驗收影像品質~Commissioning log and accepted image quality
units.title: 調試、驗收與工程交接~Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 望遠鏡交接時，工程師要交付的不是一台「裝好的機器」，而是一套可重現的狀態：致動器校正曲線、影響矩陣、查表、指向模型、影像分析儀零點與影像品質驗收數據。驗收以全系統指標進行：在量測視寧度下的星像 FWHM 與 80% 能量集中直徑、主動光學從大誤差起始的收斂時間、指向與追蹤殘差，以及儀器更換（Nasmyth 兩側）後的重現性。NTT 之後持續承接 EFOSC2、SOXS 等儀器，每次換裝都要重做這組驗證。~At handoff the engineer delivers not an assembled machine but a reproducible state: actuator calibration curves, the influence matrix, lookup tables, the pointing model, image-analyser zero points and the image-quality acceptance data. Acceptance uses whole-system metrics: stellar FWHM and 80% encircled-energy diameter at the measured seeing, the convergence time of active optics from a large initial error, pointing and tracking residuals, and repeatability after instrument changes between the two Nasmyth sides. The NTT went on to host instruments such as EFOSC2 and SOXS, and each installation repeats this verification set.
units.model: 低增益迭代的收斂：殘餘 = (1 − g)^k × 初始誤差。初始像散 1 µm、增益 g = 0.5 時，5 個週期後為 0.5⁵ ≈ 0.031，即 31 nm，5×30 s = 2.5 min 收斂到判準內；g = 0.3 時殘餘為 0.7^k，需要 9 個週期才降到 0.7⁹ ≈ 0.040，即 40 nm。穩態雜訊 σ_ss ≈ σ_m·√(g/(2−g))：σ_m ≈ 21 nm、g = 0.5 時約 12 nm。~Convergence of a low-gain iteration: residual = (1 − g)^k × initial error. With 1 µm of initial astigmatism and gain g = 0.5, five cycles leave 0.5⁵ ≈ 0.031, that is 31 nm, so 5×30 s = 2.5 min reaches the criterion; with g = 0.3 the residual is 0.7^k and nine cycles are needed to reach 0.7⁹ ≈ 0.040, that is 40 nm. Steady-state noise is σ_ss ≈ σ_m·√(g/(2−g)): with σ_m ≈ 21 nm and g = 0.5 it is about 12 nm.
units.verify: 驗收測試：故意在支撐力中注入 1 µm 像散，閉環後記錄每個週期的殘餘，確認收斂曲線符合 (1 − g)^k 且穩態殘餘低於 36 nm；同夜在三個天頂距各量一次 FWHM 與 DIMM 視寧度，寫入驗收紀錄，連同致動器校正與指向模型檔案一起歸檔並標註版本。~Acceptance test: inject 1 µm of astigmatism into the support forces on purpose, close the loop and log the residual each cycle, confirming the convergence follows (1 − g)^k with a steady-state residual below 36 nm; on the same night measure FWHM and DIMM seeing at three zenith distances, enter them in the acceptance record and archive them with the actuator calibrations and pointing-model files under a version label.
units.failure: 交接時只交付「目前能看到好星像」而沒有版本化的查表與校正檔，幾個月後換儀器或更換致動器時無人知道原始狀態，調試得從頭再來，損失數週觀測時間。~Handing over only a telescope that currently shows good images, without versioned tables and calibration files, means that months later an instrument change or actuator replacement finds nobody who knows the original state, commissioning restarts from scratch and weeks of observing time are lost.
units.misconception: 望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。~Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image.

example: 影像品質預算練習（教學假設）：大氣視寧度 0.65″，光學殘差 0.20″，追蹤抖動 0.08″ RMS（等效 FWHM 2.355×0.08 = 0.19″），圓頂視寧度 0.10″，鏡面比空氣熱 ΔT = 0.5 K 時鏡面視寧度 0.38×0.5^1.2 = 0.38×0.435 = 0.165″。望遠鏡項 RSS = √(0.20² + 0.19² + 0.165² + 0.10²) = √0.113 = 0.335″；與大氣合成 FWHM = (0.65^(5/3) + 0.335^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.488 + 0.162)^(0.6) = 0.77″。若白天溫控失效使 ΔT = 2 K，鏡面視寧度升到 0.38×2.30 = 0.87″，望遠鏡項 RSS = √(0.04 + 0.035 + 0.76 + 0.01) = 0.92″，合成 FWHM = (0.488 + 0.870)^(0.6) = 1.20″。可見 1.5 K 的鏡面溫差對影像的傷害，遠大於把光學殘差從 0.20″ 修到 0.10″ 所能換回的改善。數值為教學假設，不代表望遠鏡實際規格。~Image-quality budget exercise (teaching assumptions): atmospheric seeing 0.65″, optical residual 0.20″, tracking jitter 0.08″ RMS (equivalent FWHM 2.355×0.08 = 0.19″), dome seeing 0.10″, and mirror seeing 0.38×0.5^1.2 = 0.38×0.435 = 0.165″ for a mirror ΔT = 0.5 K warmer than the air. Telescope term RSS = √(0.20² + 0.19² + 0.165² + 0.10²) = √0.113 = 0.335″; combined with the atmosphere, FWHM = (0.65^(5/3) + 0.335^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.488 + 0.162)^(0.6) = 0.77″. If daytime temperature control fails and ΔT = 2 K, mirror seeing rises to 0.38×2.30 = 0.87″, the telescope RSS becomes √(0.04 + 0.035 + 0.76 + 0.01) = 0.92″ and the combined FWHM = (0.488 + 0.870)^(0.6) = 1.20″. A 1.5 K mirror temperature excess therefore damages the image far more than polishing the optical residual from 0.20″ to 0.10″ could ever recover. Values are teaching assumptions, not telescope specifications.
history: ESO 的 Ray Wilson 等人在 1980 年代發展主動光學理論，NTT 是第一座以此原則設計的望遠鏡：3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡坯由 Schott 鑄造，光學拋光由 Carl Zeiss 完成，八角形旋轉圓頂由義大利承包團隊於 1986 至 1989 年建造，1989 年 3 月 23 日在拉西拉天文台取得首光並得到當時少見的 0.3″ 級星像。1997 年的全面升級把控制系統改為 VLT 架構，使 NTT 成為 VLT 的技術原型；它至今仍以 EFOSC2、SOXS 等儀器運作。本課只重建公開的工程原理。~Ray Wilson and colleagues at ESO developed active-optics theory in the 1980s, and the NTT was the first telescope designed on that principle: the 3.58 m Zerodur meniscus was cast by Schott and polished by Carl Zeiss, the octagonal rotating enclosure was built by an Italian contractor team between 1986 and 1989, and first light at La Silla on 23 March 1989 delivered images near 0.3″, exceptional at the time. The 1997 overhaul rebuilt the control system on the VLT architecture, making the NTT the technical prototype of the VLT; it still operates with instruments such as EFOSC2 and SOXS. This course reconstructs only public engineering principles.
